title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds at sixty-three thousand six hundred eighty-three dollars after a one-point-three percent drop, with extreme fear at twenty-five showing no signs of easing. Hashrate stays firm at nine hundred fifty-nine exahashes while the mempool carries eighty-six thousand transactions at just one sat per vbyte. Asia trade stayed quiet overnight, with limited follow-through on the dip. Watch for a push back above sixty-four thousand or fresh selling if European flows turn heavier into the U.S. op
